summary: Class 7 ICSE Biology Topic 01: Plant & Animal Tissues in the warm editorial aesthetic (#fbfaf7 ivory canvas, Newsreader serif, rich black #161514). Features KaTeX auto-rendered math for histology classifications, Meristematic vs Permanent tissues (Parenchyma, Collenchyma, Sclerenchyma), Xylem vs Phloem vascular transport, and the 4 animal tissue systems. Zero SVGs.
